notes: Source of truth for Domain/Policy table tests; mirrors docs/roles.md section 4. A decision is necessary but not sufficient: the stage preconditions in "conditions" (key "*" applies to every role) and the read rule (view_* actions) must also pass. Actor and every *_by field come from the session. "phase" says when the action is first needed: beta (AM-first beta), reviews, client_portal, later. Condition texts that start with "On behalf" mean the activity log records actor and the named client contact. Client sign-off uses a proposed users.client_signoff column (additive), not a new role value, because users.role has a CHECK (api/db.php:70).
